messages.content: My order #4521 has not arrived yet. It has been 8 days.

I'm sorry for the delay with order #4521. Let me check the status for you. According to our records, the package is currently in transit and expected to arrive within 2 business days. Would you like me to send you the tracking link?
How do I reset my password?

You can reset your password by following these steps:
1. Go to the login page
2. Click on 'Forgot Password'
3. Enter the email associated with your account
4. Check your inbox for a reset link (valid for 30 minutes)
If you don't receive the email, please check your spam folder or contact support.

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all products. To request a refund:
1. Log into your account
2. Go to Orders → Select the order
3. Click 'Request Refund'
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
The product I received is damaged.

I'm very sorry that you received a damaged product. Please follow these steps so we can resolve this quickly:
1. Take clear photos of the damage
2. Reply with the photos and your order number
3. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund within 24 hours.
Thank you for your patience.

Yes, we ship to over 80 countries. Shipping times and costs vary by destination:
• North America / Europe: 5-10 business days
• Asia / Australia: 7-14 business days
• Rest of World: 10-20 business days
You can see exact shipping costs at checkout after entering your address.
Can I change the delivery address after placing the order?

Yes, you can change the delivery address as long as the order has not yet been shipped. Please go to your Orders page, select the order, and click 'Edit Address'. If the order is already in transit, contact us immediately and we will try our best to intercept it.
I was charged twice for the same order.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Double charges sometimes occur due to payment gateway retries. Please provide your order number and the last 4 digits of the card used. We will investigate and issue a refund for the duplicate charge within 3-5 business days.
How long does shipping usually take?
Standard shipping within the country typically takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business day delivery. You can select your preferred shipping method at checkout.
